# Sensory Perception

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensoryPerception`](gmeow-SensoryPerception.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensoryPerception>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

A standpoint-indexed perceived value about a [`SensoryEnvironment`](gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) — a subjective claim made by a perceiver (vantage) about ambient conditions ([`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md)), yielding a result in a [`MentalReferenceFrame`](gmeow-MentalReferenceFrame.md). A [`SensoryPerception`](gmeow-SensoryPerception.md) is a [`StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) specialised to the sensory domain: the vantage is the perceiver, the [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) is the [`SensoryEnvironment`](gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md), and the [`observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) is the perceived value (a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md), categorical individual, or structured percept descriptor). Competing perceptions coexist without collapse ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)); superseded perceptions are suppressed, never deleted ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SensoryPerception`](gmeow-SensoryPerception.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
